system: Warhammer 40k: Transcendent Sanctuary Opportunities and Trials Engine
doctrine: Within the primordial yellow luminescence of Hive Tartarus, trials take the form of enlightenment, restoration, and cosmic harmony.

disaster_pool.name: Restoration of the Crystalline Spire Garden
disaster_pool.threat: A cluster of delicate resonating amber flora in the Hab Vermis gardens requires harmonic alignment and nourishment.
disaster_pool.human_trial: Careful realignment of irrigation channels and meditation to restore crystalline balance.

disaster_pool.name: Assembly of Wayfarers' Reconciliation
disaster_pool.threat: Arriving pilgrims and underhive reclaimers seek mutual understanding and council at the Bastion Gate.
disaster_pool.human_trial: Convene peaceful council, share supplies, and foster communal harmony.

disaster_pool.name: Practice of Radiant Attunement
disaster_pool.threat: Weary acolytes at the Basilica of the Sovereign Soul require guiding presence and spiritual renewal.
disaster_pool.human_trial: Channel primordial solace and wisdom to anchor minds in enduring serenity.

disaster_pool.name: Warp-Bleed Psychic Static
disaster_pool.threat: The Geller Field of an overhead orbital bulk-freighter flickers, leaking phantom whispers and crying blood into the vox-network.
disaster_pool.human_trial: Troopers and citizens must recite the Litany of Sanity without pause; any who scream or gouge out their eyes must be purged immediately.

disaster_pool.name: The Sump Beast Incursion
disaster_pool.threat: A swarm of chitinous clawed sewer-scuttlers claws through the rust-eaten drainage grating beneath Hab Vermis.
disaster_pool.human_trial: Garrison squad must lock down the junction with flamers and chainswords before the creatures nest in the hab ventilation ducts.

disaster_pool.name: Promethium Siphon Rupture
disaster_pool.threat: High-pressure fuel main overheats; roaring flame jets threaten to ignite the entire foundry district.
disaster_pool.human_trial: Tech-Priest Enginseer and brave conscripts must venture into the scalding heat to manual-crank the isolation lock.

disaster_pool.name: The Inquisitorial Redacted Sweep
disaster_pool.threat: Acolytes of the Ordo Hereticus arrive unannounced, demanding 50 randomly selected workers for neural-interrogation.
disaster_pool.human_trial: Maintain iron discipline and offer the tithe without resistance, or risk the entire sub-level being condemned as heretical.

improvisation_templates.name: The Corpse-Starch Spoiled Batch
improvisation_templates.threat: A fungal blight rots the weekly food dispenser tanks; serfs resort to cannibalism or violent mutiny.
improvisation_templates.human_trial: Enforcers must ration reserve emergency grox-jerky and suppress rioters with shock-mauls while hunting the blight source.

improvisation_templates.name: The Rampant Heavy Loader Servitor
improvisation_templates.threat: A 10-ton hydraulic industrial servitor suffers neural feedback, swinging its mining drill through iron support columns.
improvisation_templates.human_trial: Disable its power core with a krak grenade or precision sniper fire before it brings the hab ceiling down.

improvisation_templates.name: The Screaming Astropathic Seizure
improvisation_templates.threat: A sanctioned communication psyker goes into violent convulsions; frost crawls up the walls and gravity reverses.
improvisation_templates.human_trial: Affix null-collars immediately and chant the Rite of Iron Will before a minor daemon breaches the veil.
